answer: What keeps this honest is GitHub account age and history proof, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 779 aliases would need 779 separate proofs, each costing about 95 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the tide up to the light, weigh the basalt of the attack, and keep the ivory of the verdict where everyone can audit it. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
